fixtureSelection.digest: SHA-256 over sorted repository-relative file paths and bytes

runModes.cold: The first scan invocation for each fixture in a fresh benchmark process.
runModes.warm: Subsequent scan invocations for the same fixture in that process after module and parser initialization.

accuracy.denominator: expected records in the fixture's checked-in expected artifact
accuracy.precision: true-positive emitted records divided by all emitted records
accuracy.recall: true-positive emitted records divided by all expected records
accuracy.unsupported: records outside an expected artifact are not counted as supported accuracy
accuracy.families: Expected artifacts may declare edge-kind, endpoint-prefix, and diagnostic-code selectors; the runner reports precision and recall for each declared family. Selectors may overlap when one record represents multiple construct families.

variance.acceptableRegression: A result over 20% slower than the recorded baseline requires an explanation before release.
